The '''Zirulast system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Zirulast]]. It lay on the [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route of [[Ootmian Pabol/Legends|Ootmian Pabol]].
